nom: Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Leaf Face & Body Bar Soap

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the bar leaves them soft, smooth and not stripped, though a couple say it dried their face out or made skin feel grippy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, no breakouts and a soft, calm finish, with only one review noting a rash risk from other products (not this one) and none reporting a bad reaction to this soap itself.
segments.combination: The one combination-skin reviewer found it left her skin feeling grippy and over-dried, saying the bar 'is just simply not for my skin type.'
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers say it cuts down shine and oiliness through the day without over-drying, letting them go longer before their face looks shiny again.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the bar as moisturizing and non-drying, leaving skin soft and hydrated even in dry climates; a minority (including one dry-skin and one combination-skin reviewer) report it dried out or 'sucked the moisture' from their skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the bar calmed active redness, bumps and a forming cyst within a few days of switching to it.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or psoriasis describe fewer flare-ups, less cracking, and a soap that cleans without stripping the skin's protective barrier.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers say the aloe helped fade dark or acne-related spots and brighten complexion, though effects are described as gradual and not yet fully confirmed at the time of writing.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with regular use, including one whose son's skin reportedly improved markedly within a week; no reviewer reports new breakouts caused by the soap.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and oil buildup over the course of the day after switching to this soap.

aspects.libelle: Bumps uncomfortable or confusing on face
Scent too faint or fades fast

extraits.texte: I love the mild scent of this body bar and the way it goes onto the skin. It seems to clean the skin very very well. I have combination skin, it left my skin very grippy feeling and dried me out pretty good. This might not happen to everyone so I would certainly give it a try. It's just simply not for my skin type

OMG Guys this is by far one of my new favorite lines of products. I use UH Shea lotion and I love it, so I decided to try out he face soap...I love it. I am usually very skeptical about face products since I have extremely sensitive skin and I have to be very careful with the products I use. This Aloe Vera face soap is super clean, it vegan, paraben and sulfate free. It doesn't leave a nasty soap film on your skin, my skin feel smooth and moisturized. It smells amazing with hints of coconut and aloe, but it's not too aggressive to cause break-outs. I love that the bar has bumps and act as a built-in massager. It really makes my skin feel nourished and soft.

As someone with psoriasis too easily triggered by colder weather (I swear my body knows the exact date fall starts), this soap - and their whole line of products - is something I never want to be without. Between the cold, dry air and frequent hand washing, the skin on my poor hands flares up and doesnt settle down until May. After almost of year of waiting and using Urban Hydration's other products, this bar soap FINALLY got stocked. Immediately ordered six bars because I knew how amazing their other aloe products were, and this bar did not disappoint. Non-drying, non-irritating, barely has a scent, rinses off cleanely without completely stripping every bit of your skin's protective barrier. My cuticles are less dry and ragged. Even my nails do better with this soap. I wish Ulta sold the line in our local stores. I'd drive to each one and buy all the bars of soap I could get! But seriously…if you, a family member, or friend deal with eczema, psoriasis, or have dry or easily irritated skin as a side effect of medication or other medical condition, please let them know about this soap and skin lotion in the same aloe line. If you read this, Ulta - PLEASE start selling in this multipacks so those of us who don't wish to ever be without this wonder soap will have an easy way to order a whole case at a time.

Aloe is fantastic for dry, sensitive, and inflamed skin. I learned this after using a sample of a different product, so this Aloe face and body bar seemed perfect for my dry skin and rosacea prone face. I was honestly blown away by how much I love this beautifully simple bar of soap! It creates the most luscious, silky lather that feels like a spa treatment even if I'm doing a quick face wash before bed. My rosacea was starting to flare when I got the Aloe soap, and I tend to have lots of redness, bumps, and even deep cysts that take a long, painful while to heal. Not this time! Seriously, I thought I was headed for a few weeks of painful struggle to get my skin calmed. The only thing I changed about my routine was the Aloe bar, and the redness, bumps and that ugly cyst near my nose that I could see forming have all calmed down within a few days. My skin is so soft, too! I'm not saying it's magic and my face is perfect now, but I am saying that it stopped the acute inflammation that was making my face miserable. My face feels good, and I'm confident this Aloe bar will continue to help the healing process. And I love it for body wash as well. It is really moisturizing and has helped all those trouble dry spots. The silky lather is amazing for shaving! It creates a lather that all those shaving gels wish they could be. extraits.titre: Leaves my skin feeling absolutely amazing!
extraits.texte: As soon as I opened the packaging, I immediately noticed the light minty scent and it smells absolutely amazing! I have been using this face and body soap for the past few days and I am super impressed! I have dry skin and this soap is a life saver! My skin feels so soft and hydrated! I have tried an array of other soaps which only left my skin feeling more dried out. This soap leaves my skin feeling amazing! The bar itself lathers up great and the rinses well leaving no soap residue on your skin. The bar has bumps on it which feels great on your skin! It is like you're getting a gentle massage all while cleaning your skin! I can't wait to see what this soap will do for my skin with continued use of this product! I also love that there are no harsh chemicals in this soap and that it is made with Aloe and Coconut Oil. This will now be my new brand of soap for my whole family. If you are looking for a soap that leaves your skin not only clean but feeling incredible, I definitely recommend this one by Urban Hydration!

I love this bar for my face. The lather is quick and nice. It goes on my face and rinses clean. I usually have a shiny, oily face within an hour. Thanks to this soap I can get through half the day. The must needed extra bonus is it does not dry out my face or body. I am a hard one with an oily face and eczema on my hands and arms, but this soap stands up to them both.

extraits.titre: Love this soap for my face
extraits.texte: I've been using this soap for 2 weeks now. I've noticed that my face is less shiny and oily. It's really a great deep cleaning soap. My face isn't dry at all and normally when the weather changes here in the Midwest my face gets very dry. This bar of soap will really last a long time. After 2 weeks it still looks like new.
